{"code": "import numpy as np

def analyze(inputs, outputs):
    for i, (inp, out) in enumerate(zip(inputs, outputs)):
        s = sum(inp)
        n = len(inp)
        avg = s / n
        evens = [x for x in inp if x % 2 == 0]
        odds = [x for x in inp if x % 2 != 0]
        sum_e = sum(evens)
        sum_o = sum(odds)
        diff_eo = sum_e - sum_o
        print(f"In {i+1}: Sum={s}, Len={n}, Mean={avg:.2f}, DiffEO={diff_eo}, Range={max(inp)-min(inp)}, Out={out}")

outputs = [[1], [75], [16], [0]]
analyze(inputs, outputs)"}
